title: Straight Torque Adapter at 90 Degrees
introduction:
The adapter’s name describes the tool; the drawing shows how to position it. I check for the L-shaped arrangement: the adapter extends sideways from the torque-wrench head, with its fastener end below the head in this view. That little sideways reach is the whole point of this reference.

Match the illustrated angle, check the adapter against the length limit below, and use the fastener specification in the workshop manual. This page covers that arrangement only; it supplies no alternative setting or calculation for a different angle or adapter length.

items.name: Fastener specification
items.detail: Have the workshop-manual tightening specification for the particular fastener available.

items.name: Adapter suitability
items.detail: Confirm that the adapter meets the stated length limit and can be positioned as illustrated.
